## Type Aliases

### AccessTicket

```ts
type AccessTicket = 
  | "invite-code"
  | "access-link"
  | "invitation"
  | "waitlist"
  | "workspace-invitation"
  | "gift"
  | "domain"
  | "administrator";
```

Defined in: [src/convex/access-tickets.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/access-tickets.ts)

What admitted a new address while the app was closed, as the redemption
ledger, the activity trail and `canSignIn` name it:

- `invite-code` and `access-link`: an administrator's code or link.
- `invitation`: an administrator invited the address (`access.admit`, the Access tab).
- `waitlist`: an administrator admitted the address's waitlist entry.
- `workspace-invitation`: a pending, unexpired invitation to a workspace.
- `gift`: a paid, unclaimed gift addressed to it.
- `domain`: its domain is one of `setupAccess`'s `domains`.
- `administrator`: an administrator created the account.

***

type WaitlistQuestions = Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>;

## Functions

### setupAccess()

```ts
function setupAccess(components, options): Access;
```

Defined in: [src/convex/integrations/launch.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/launch.ts)

Launch your app in phases: early access with a waitlist, then invite
only, then public. Existing accounts always sign in. While the app is
closed, a new address needs a ticket: an invite code or an access link,
an invitation by address, an admitted waitlist entry, a pending
workspace invitation, a paid gift addressed to it, or a domain of
`domains`. Pass the result to `setupAuth({ access })`: its sign-in
hooks ask the phase and take the ticket. An administrator changes the
phase and hands out tickets from the admin console's Access tab.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `components` | [`AccessComponents`](#accesscomponents) |
| `options` | [`SetupAccessOptions`](#setupaccessoptions) |

#### Returns

[`Access`](#access)

#### Example

```ts [backend/access.ts]
import { setupAccess } from 'nuxt-backend/access'
import { components } from './_generated/api'
import { audit } from './audit'

export const access = setupAccess(components, {
  phases: ['early-access', 'invite-only', 'public'],
  domains: ['panels.example'],
  audit,
})

export const { getAccessPhase, checkInvite, getAccessConsole, setAccessPhase, createInvite, revokeInvite, admitEmails } = access.api
```

***

### setupWaitlist()

```ts
function setupWaitlist(components, options): Waitlist;
```

Defined in: [src/convex/integrations/waitlist.ts](https://github.com/qruto/nuxt-backend/blob/main/src/convex/integrations/waitlist.ts)

Run a waitlist for early access: joins proven by the sign-in code (the
double opt-in), a place for everyone waiting, a boost for each friend who
joins through their link, waves an administrator admits from the console's
Waitlist tab, and a mirror of the people who asked for launch news to the
email provider. It is built on [Access](#access): an app whose phases
include `early-access` records an entry whenever a new address's code
checks, and an admitted entry is a ticket.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `components` | [`AccessComponents`](#accesscomponents) |
| `options` | [`SetupWaitlistOptions`](#setupwaitlistoptions) |

#### Returns

[`Waitlist`](#waitlist)

#### Example

```ts [backend/waitlist.ts]
import { setupWaitlist } from 'nuxt-backend/access'
import { components } from './_generated/api'
import { access } from './access'
import { email } from './email'
import { paths } from './paths.generated'

export const waitlist = setupWaitlist(components, {
  access,
  email,
  paths,
  questions: { role: ['Writer', 'Illustrator', 'Reader'] },
})

export const { getWaitlistQuestions, joinWaitlist, waitlistStatus, leaveWaitlist, getWaitlistConsole, admitWaitlist, declineWaitlist, noteWaitlist, getWaitlistCaps } = waitlist.api
```
